description: Tolerance sampling of the expander/focus design with refocus compensation: L2 axial position (uniform +-2 mm) and source waist radius (normal, sigma 5 um, truncated at 3 sigma) are sampled; for each sample the focus-plane axial position is solved within +-2 mm to minimise the spot radius, and the as-built and compensated results are both recorded. Run with --no-compensation for the same samples without it. The top-level max_evaluations caps the planned runs (nominal plus one per sample); compensation.max_evaluations separately caps the solver's trial runs per sample.

compensation.description: refocus: move the focus plane along the axis
